| description = Hoshkar ("Hosh") is usually the second roaming dragon encountered in a normal VP crawl.

Due to his AE (slow + DD), Hoshkar is often considered the hardest dragon in [[Veeshan's Peak]]. Clerics may use [[Word of Restoration]] to cure their group. Hosh gates.

[Oct2001] Shissar Apothic Staff is replaced by Shissar Protection Staff on Hoshkar's loot table. {{Era Short | Chardok}} [https://project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=410915]
